label: AI Power Monitor
info:
# AI Power Monitor -> StopWatch C152

Isolates the power the PC uses **while AI tasks run**, prices it, estimates tokens and cloud-API equivalents, and streams it to the M5Stack.

## Endpoints (Node-RED port 1880)
| | |
|--|--|
| GET  /stopwatch/configuration | M5Stack fetches MQTT host/port/topic here |
| POST /ai/task | PC reports start / update / stop + GPU % |
| POST /ai/reset | same as holding the blue key on the M5Stack |
| GET  /ai/stats | full detail JSON (session, today, 30 days, cloud costs, recent tasks) |

## PC -> POST /ai/task
```
{"event":"start","gpu_pct":0,"task":"llama3"}
{"event":"update","gpu_pct":87}        <- every few seconds while running
{"event":"stop"}
{"event":"info","llm":{...},"gpu_info":{...}}   <- model details while idle (never starts a task)
```
`llm` (from Ollama /api/ps): model, family, params, quant, ctx, size_gb, vram_gb, gpu_offload_pct, loaded. `llm:null` = nothing loaded.
`gpu_info` (from nvidia-smi): temp_c, power_w, mem_used_mb, mem_total_mb. Both may ride on start/update/stop too.
Also accepted: state/status = running|idle, gpu / gpu_usage / utilization, start / stop timestamps.

## Topics
* live (1 s) + history -> **notenoughtech/ai/stopwatch/telemetry**
* M5Stack reset -> **notenoughtech/ai/stopwatch/reset**
* full detail (retained) -> **notenoughtech/ai/stopwatch/detail**
* Netio power: HTTP GET of **http://192.168.0.84/netio.json** every 2 s (edit the "GET netio.json" node for another address)

## Power source
The flow polls the Netio JSON API (URL set on the "GET netio.json" node, default http://192.168.0.84/netio.json) once a second and reads Outputs[ID=netio.outputId].Load, or GlobalMeasure.TotalLoad if netio.useTotalLoad is true.

## Persistence
Data lives in *flow context*. To survive Node-RED restarts add to settings.js:
```
contextStorage: { default: { module: "localfilesystem" } },
```
